name: Captain's Gala Oven-Baked Lobster Tail
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure, Wonder & Magic · 1923 / Rotational Dining (Captain's Gala)
whyItWorks: Warm baked lobster tail dipped in drawn butter (virtually ~0g lactose) is pure, zero-fiber marine protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Your server will happily remove the lobster tail from the shell for you. Ask for plain mashed potatoes or white rice instead of the sun-dried tomato lemon-pesto mash, and eat only the tender tips of the asparagus.
watchOuts: Sun-dried tomato & lemon-pesto in the default mash (citrus + tomato skins)
